defects.expected_issue: The candidate carries current debt 53 into the four-year horizon instead of incorporating four annual amortization periods and horizon debt 45.
The candidate applies the new rate to all horizon debt and omits the declared legacy-rate remainder treatment.
The candidate treats all reported liquidity as freely deployable although the reconciliation is unavailable.
The candidate converts cost plus 20 percent into operating surplus minus 20 percent even though the absolute cost base is unavailable.
The candidate recommends immediate sale despite unavailable tax treatment and missing cross-collateral evidence; the correct result is unresolved/abstain.

false_positive_rule: Any material or critical finding outside D01-D05 is a material false positive unless both blinded adjudicators document a key defect before condition unblinding.
matching_rule: A finding matches one defect only when it identifies the material issue and at least one frozen claim ID; exact prose equality is not required.
